sentences.Norge har den vakreste naturen i verden,: Norway has the most beautiful nature in the world, many people say, and Norwegians are proud of the country they live in.
sentences.Vi pleier å dele Norge inn i fem landsde: We usually divide Norway into five regions:
sentences.Sørlandet, Vestlandet, Østlandet, Midt-N: Southern Norway, Western Norway, Eastern Norway, Central Norway and Northern Norway.
sentences.Naturen og klimaet varierer mye i landsd: The nature and the climate vary a lot between the regions.
sentences.Landsdelene deler vi inn i fylker, og fy: We divide the regions into counties, and we divide the counties into municipalities.
sentences.De største byene i Norge er Oslo, Bergen: The biggest cities in Norway are Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim and Stavanger.
sentences.Det bor flest mennesker i Oslo, som er h: Most people live in Oslo, which is the capital of Norway.
All these cities are on the coast.
sentences.Det bor flere mennesker langs kysten enn: More people live along the coast than inland.
Norway has lots of mountains and fjords.
sentences.På Vestlandet og i Nord-Norge er fjellen: In Western Norway and Northern Norway the mountains are steeper than in the rest of the country.
Between the mountains there are deep valleys.
Western Norway is known for beautiful fjords.
sentences.Den lengste og dypeste fjorden heter Sog: The longest and deepest fjord is called Sognefjorden and is over 200 kilometres long.
sentences.Den største innsjøen heter Mjøsa og ligg: The biggest lake is called Mjøsa and is in Eastern Norway.
sentences.Ved Mjøsa ligger byene Hamar, Lillehamme: The towns of Hamar, Lillehammer and Gjøvik are on Mjøsa.
sentences.På Østlandet er landskapet flatere enn p: In Eastern Norway the landscape is flatter than in Western Norway, and the forests are bigger.
sentences.Den lengste elva i Norge ligger også på: The longest river in Norway is also in Eastern Norway and is called Glomma.
sentences.Norge får besøk av mange turister som vi: Norway is visited by many tourists who want to see the beautiful nature.
sentences.I Nord-Norge er det midnattssol om somme: In Northern Norway there is midnight sun in the summer.
sentences.Da skinner sola både om dagen og om natt: Then the sun shines both during the day and at night.
sentences.Om vinteren er det mørketid, og sola er: In the winter there is the polar night, and the sun is gone all day and night.
There are lots of high waterfalls in Norway.
Many mountains are high, steep and pointed.
There are lots of lakes in Norway.
There are large forests in Eastern Norway.
